Actually precisely: state = longest prefix of [x,y] that's a suffix of w: if w ends with y and before that x → 2; if w ends with x → 1; else 0. And 2 is absorbing.

Product over atoms (x_i, y_i): the tuple is determined by w: for each i, whether x_i y_i occurred (absorbing bit), plus whether the last token is x_i. Hmm, with the last token being a single value t: for atom i, state is 1 iff t == x_i (and not already absorbing). So the non-absorbing part contributes: (last token, set of absorbed atoms). The absorbed set grows monotonically. The number of reachable tuples: consider w; the state = (last token t, absorbed set A). A = set of atoms whose pattern occurred in w. As w varies, we can absorb atoms one at a time... but the reachable combos are constrained: after reading t, the new absorbed atoms are those i with x_i y_i where y_i... hmm wait, the transition: state 1 + read y → 2. So the last two tokens t_{-1} t_0 = x_i y_i → atom i becomes absorbed.

So the reachable states are (t, A) where A is any set of atoms that can be "collected" in some order... Since patterns are pairs of distinct tokens, we can construct w to absorb any subset in any order (reading x_i y_i for each i in sequence). But the last token t matters: the state is (t, A). Hmm, and also atoms with x_i = t are in state 1 vs 0. So the state is (t, A) where t ∈ Σ. But careful: when we read t after absorbing, an atom i with x_i = t is in state 1 (if not absorbed).

So reachable tuples = {(t, A) : t ∈ Σ, A ⊆ atoms reachable-collectible} — but is every combination reachable? To reach (t, A) with |A| = k, we need a word ending in t that has absorbed exactly A. We can absorb the atoms of A in any order and then append t (if t doesn't accidentally absorb more or... appending t might create a new pattern x_i y_i = (something, t) if y_i = t and the previous token was x_i). We can choose the absorbing sequence carefully to avoid extras. Roughly, the count ≈ |Σ| · 2^n + something. With n = 10 atoms and |Σ| = 24: 24 · 1024 = 24576 > 20000. With |Σ| = 19: 19·1024 = 19456.
